summary_method: Arithmetic means of two per-run summaries with reversed execution order. These are not percentiles of pooled frame timings or an aggregate desktop speedup.
checks: The forward run checks four lossless frames per case against every expected RGB pixel and matching baseline/candidate hashes; reverse disables replay explicitly. Both runs verify immutable image/source provenance and use the same shipped twelve-worker admission.
limitations: Synthetic unpaced server planning/FIFO/encoding/serialization only; no capture, RDP transport, browser painting, Wi-Fi or physical input. Existing search phase includes indexing, uses integer-ms wall timing and is not CPU. The full-wallpaper total-cost comparison is confounded by differing adaptive encoded output and is not a controlled equal-quality planner comparison.
selection_history: Earlier unshipped candidates exposed ordinary-workload overhead. Row-boundary exhaustion removed the per-window stop branch; scalar fixed-cell indexing then removed a full rolling-array clear for each indexed tile. Only the final source-matched records below represent the deployed implementation. Operational exploratory records remain outside Git.

summary.interpretation: Exclude total frame/CPU gain from headline or aggregate gains: forward encoded byte volume changes substantially; existing automatic encoding decisions differ.

Unresolved order-sensitive p95 increase (+9.86% mean): forward is nearly flat, reverse is +18.78%; median improves and CPU is nearly unchanged. Neither a proven planner regression nor proven harmless jitter.

forward.measurement: production display planner, copy search, FIFO, workers, codecs and serialization to a shared discard socket
forward.limitations: synthetic fixtures; no capture, RDP transport, browser, Wi-Fi, physical input or frame pacing; copied pixels/planner/encoding included, fixture generation excluded
forward.fixture_note: original nine scenarios preserved; added all-solid, zero-copy-hit, early/late exact-copy-hit and alternating-size planner-reuse fixtures
forward.policy_note: baseline never calls the setter and preserves its shipped policy (including private.6 default12); adaptive passes setter value1, enabling the candidate default12 rather than limiting it to one worker; only values greater than1 override the adaptive cap; fixed passes0 as a separate full-pool diagnostic; test_active_cap is the legacy setter-control value, not necessarily an observed worker count
forward.verification: separate untimed strict ASCII protocol replay with real PNG/lossless WebP decoding and exact RGB comparison of every fixture pixel after each checked frame; timing/RSS captured before verification; opaque fixed-size fixtures only, not a general browser or alpha/resize validator
forward.statistics_note: planner counter deltas cover measured frames only; scratch bytes are retained-capacity gauges; unavailable baseline counters are null, not zero
forward.planning_phase_timing_note: existing numeric TRACE phase durations captured without formatting; per-frame mean/p95 use integer-millisecond wall times; search includes both candidate indexing and copy search; zero phase durations are valid; phase quantiles cannot be subtracted from full-frame quantiles

encoding_note: Timed output retains existing framerate-dependent PNG/WebP/JPEG selection. The full-wallpaper forward run changes protocol bytes from about 18.5 MB to 3.7 MB/frame while planned image area/admission stay the same; the reverse run does not show that gain. Existing adaptive encoding is a plausible contributor. Do not treat its aggregate timing as an isolated planner gain or equal-quality comparison. The separate forced-lossless replay checks exact RGB correctness.
